description.narrative:
EcoContact har ansökt hos Sveriges ambassad om finansiering av 20 440 001 SEK för att genomföra projektet "Green Justice 2021-2025" i Moldavien under perioden 2021-2025.
Projektet Green Justice syftar till att förbättra de rättsliga och institutionella ramarna för miljöstyrning och juridik och att uppnå ett starkare engagemang och samarbete mellan alla nyckelaktörer inom miljöskyddet på nationell och lokal nivå. Projektets aktiviteter är utformade för att uppnå detta mål, med hänsyn till EcoContacts erfarenhet, liksom dess institutionella och icke-statliga partner, och genomförandet av en rad studier om de viktigaste tematiska insatsområdena. Som ett resultat kommer de behöriga statliga och regionala myndigheternas reglerings- och institutionella kapacitet att stärkas och en högre överensstämmelse med genomförandet och efterlevnaden av miljölagstiftningen uppnås.

EcoContact has applied to Embassy of Sweden for funding of 20 440 001 SEK to carry out the Project "Green Justice 2021-2025" in Moldova during the period 2021-2025.
The Green Justice project is aiming at improving the legal and institutional framework of environmental governance and justice and to achieve stronger involvement and cooperation of all key players in the environmental protection at the national and local levels. The project activities are designed to implement this objective, taking into account the experience of the EcoContact, as well as its institutional and NGO partners, and undertaking a series of studies on the main thematic areas of intervention. As a result, the regulatory and institutional capacity of competent state and regional authorities will be strengthened and a higher compliance with the implementation and enforcement of environmental law achieved.

The main objective of Green Justice project is to improve the legal and institutional framework of environmental governance and justice and to achieve stronger involvement and cooperation of all key players at national and local level.

1) A better understanding of the priorities for improvement of the environmental governance and justice in Moldova, communicated to and discussed with stakeholders. 2) Increased level of knowledge and improved skills of lawyers, civil society, and authorities to address the most pressing environmental problems. 3) A higher level of implementation, compliance, and enforcement to address most pressing environmental problems. 4) Targeted legal support on environmental cases / disputes in place, reduction of risks and consequences of environmental damage. 5) A better understanding of and support for projects objectives, activities, and results among the stakeholders and general public.
EcoContact has progressed within all 5 components of the project. Among examples of results of the project is the development of studies to be used by governmental authorities, such as: - The functional analysis of the environmental sector and the institutional analysis of the Environmental Protection Inspectorate and the "Moldsilva" Agency - Integrated study on governance and human rights in the Republic of Moldova(including HR and environment) - Roadmap concerning overcoming existing barriers in investigation of ecological crimes - Analysis of the effectiveness of the regulatory framework in the field of hunting fundmanagement and hunting - Environmental Human Rights Defenders Guide Also, EcoContact supported the Minsintry of Environment in drafting and promotiong normative acts, for example: Law on hunting (in review, supporting the WG activity), Law on Industrial Emissions (approved by the parliament in 2022), Law on Environmental Impact Assessment (approved by the parliament in 2022), Law on the foundation of the "Lower Dniester" National Park and amendment of Law no. 1538/1998 regarding the fund of natural areas protected by the state (approved in 2022), Forestry Code, Draft Gov.Dec on approval of regulation on eco-labelling, Law on Industrial Emissions, Law on Environmental Impact Assessment etc _____________________________ During 2023, all the activities foreseen within the Green Justice were conducted within all 5 project components, undertaken according to project RAF and the proposed action plan. The project has achieved a significant results working on policy framework supporting the Ministry of Environment on alignment the national legislation to European Union requirements. An important milestone in this area is the development of National Environmental Strategy for 2024-2030. Also, the project contributed to the development of environmental documents, such as: normative acts, draft law and codes, draft governmental decisions, Ministry of Environment decrees, legal consultations and opinions on various drafts of policy and legal documents issued. Within the project were advertised several calls for proposals of submitting the project. In conclusion, during the 2023 period 12 NGOs benefited from project sub-granting scheme. Within the project were developed the Local Environmental Platforms in 7 districts of the country. Also, by Green Justice project were supported a list of raising awareness and capacity building activities, such as: Bi-annual forum of environmental NGOs; joint regional training sessions for prosecutors; thematic trainings for subdivision of Environmental Protection Inspections; sessions of cycle of trainings for prosecutors and judges on environmental law and particularities of investigation and examination of the environmental crimes; international scientific conferences. ___________________________ The results mentioned below have been achieved during the third year of project implementation period January - December 2024. During 2024, all the activities were conducted within all 5 project components, undertaken according to project RAF and the proposed action plan. Major outputs achieved during the reporting period include: Policy document development finalization of National Environmental Strategy for 2024-2030 Gov. Decision nr 409/2024. The strategy is based on 8 priority objectives and provides the set of indicators to track the Strategy Implementation process. Project secured the translation of the Strategy in 2 languages (Romanian, Russian and English). It has been officially approved by the government on June 12, 2024. Policy drafting support a team of experts conducted the Strategic Environmental Assessment (SEA) to the draft Nistru River Basin District Management Plan, Cycle II (20252029). Support to the Ministry of Environment on preparation for screening and presentations for EU Integration process under Chapter 27. A comprehensive and structured analysis of the general situation related to Chapter 27 "Environment" has been completed. The analysis was organized into ten thematic subchapters, EcoContact experts provided support for: Horizontal Legislation, Water Quality, Nature Protection and Biodiversity Conservation, Industrial Emissions. Legal drafting support was provided to the Ministry of Environment for the elaboration and promotion of one law, six Government Decisions, and two Ministerial Orders. Additionally, in 2024, EcoContact reviewed draft legal acts and, based on these analyses, developed and submitted 59 opinions on draft normative acts to central and local public authorities as part of the lawmaking endorsement procedure. Increase capacities of stakeholders in implementation the new environmental legislation EcoContact in partnership with the Ministry of Environment and the American Chamber of Commerce conducted during 2024, four trainings in order to apply the newly developed regulatory framework in the field of the environment, three of which were dedicated to the business and the fourth to Environment Agency and the Environmental Protection Inspectorate. Developing capacities of environmental inspectors to apply new procedure on integrated environmental control. Thematic workshop for 70 representatives of the Environmental Protection Inspectorate on integrated environmental control procedures was organized in October 2024. Raising and debating the crucial and new topics to the environmental and legal issues between professionals was hosted during the Multistakeholder round table "Perspectives and challenges in combating environmental crimes in the context of the new amendments to the Criminal Code". 2 sessions of cycle of trainings (6 in total) for prosecutors and judges on environmental law and particularities of investigation and examination of the environmental crimes. Facilitation of the exchange of experience and lessons learned in the implementation of newly adopted environmental legislation in Moldova through a study visit to Romania, organized on on March 1920, 2024. Subgranting activity for 12 NGOs with thematic Active citizens for a healthy environment and green justice. Subgranting activity for 4 mass media with thematic "Community journalism for a healthy environment and green justice". Ensuring the correct application and understanding of the environmental legislation 10 Legal consultations were provided by Aarhus Center (4 urban cases and 6 rural). Drafting and widely disseminated the civil society positions and declarations on environmental infringements as a part of Moldova Civil Society/ Eastern Partnership. Academic School on Environmental Education for 40 students studying at the law faculties of USM, USARB, B.P. Hasdeu University of Cahul, Police Academy (MAI) April 17 19, 2024. For three days, students have been guided by trainers lawyers, researchers, prosecutors and environmental law experts who address key topics such as the right to a healthy environment, criminal liability for the destruction of natural resources, European environmental jurisprudence, combating environmental crimes and the protection of environmental rights defenders. Sessions were combined with visits to environmental institutions (SHS, ICAS, Env. Agency). Supporting the implementation of environmental legislation and ensuring dialogue at local level through Seven local environmental platforms in the districts of Balti, Cahul, Criuleni, Faleti, Hînceti, Stefan Voda, Ialoveni. National Drawing competition among lyceums dedicated to Waste Prevention and Recycling, organized in frames of activity of the Local Environmental Platforms, gathered more than 400 participants from 7 raions. One national campaign on waste prevention and recycling launched and promoted on monthly basis through the dedicated postings and activities of the project and the SGP beneficiaries. Podcast "reMediu pentru MEDIU cu Justiie Verde" was launched in partnership with EcoFM. 4 out of 10 editions was launched in 2024, on the topics of public interest related to environmental protection, sustainability and green justice. EcoContact representatives were also nominated and closely worked under the various legal and policy document development within 5 interministerial Working Groups (support to specific chapters under the PNA (Eastern Partnership CSO group and WG on Chapter 27 created by MoEnv), surface water normative documents elaboration, waste management group).
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
